name: mirage
text: v1.0.122 is out: https://github.com/tjshea90/novig/releases/tag/v1.0.122 . The slow open: at start the app read and parsed about 3 MB of Novig wallet history on the main thread before drawing anything; it now does that in the background. I can't prove that is the whole 9 seconds from here. The close on the first open after an update I could not trace from here. If it happens again after this update, open Settings > Diagnostics and send the report, and I'll read the crash line.
